description: Make an original instrumental song from a description: genre, mood, instruments, tempo, what it's for. Returns it queued; the player in the chat shows it rendering and plays it when it's done (about a minute), with MP3 and WAV downloads and its five stems (drums, bass, guitar, keys, other) as FLAC. Where there's no player, get_song gives those links once it's done. Artist names are not allowed and are removed from prompts before generation: describe the sound instead. Royalty-free, for commercial games and videos. It makes sound effects too, with nothing to switch: a description with no music in it ("heavy rain on a tin roof", "a sword clashing against a metal shield") comes back as a sound effect, one take up to 30 seconds with MP3 and WAV and no stems, and its kind is "sfx".

bpm.description: Tempo; left out, it's chosen from the prompt.

key.description: A note with sharps and major or minor, like "C major" or "F# minor".

loop.description: A seamless loop, for a game level or a background.

prompt.description: The music in words, e.g. "a calm village theme with flute and harp", or a sound with no music in it for a sound effect, e.g. "footsteps on gravel".

seed.description: Makes the same song again from the same words and settings; left out, a new one each time.

variations.description: How many versions of it to make (default 1). Two count as one song.

name: create_song
title: Make a song
